verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a Quick Start and a Tooling Guide, and a community user confirms the official vue-cli scaffolds projects with the official router and store very easily. Another user notes Vite as a lighter dev setup, so the core story of official starter tooling is delivered. One user reported days spent configuring builds, which tempers confidence but does not contradict the scaffolding itself. Missing for 10: first-party detail on the current scaffolding command and workflow (the doc evidence is titles only), and evidence of the 'few minutes' time-to-running-app.
